headline: Fuel prices this morning, 11/10: E10 RON95 and E5 RON92 may drop sharply next period, Diesel even cheaper, and the cost to fill a Honda motorbike
summary: The retail price of E10 RON95 is 28,250 dong per litre, and E5 RON92 is no higher than 27,770 dong. Prices may drop sharply in the next period, with diesel even cheaper.
why: Retail fuel prices in Vietnam are set periodically and track global crude and refined product costs, affecting transport and inflation.
